name: Karnataka
intro: Hampi's boulder-strewn ruins, the Chalukya temples of Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal, Hoysala masterpieces at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura, Mysuru's palace and Dasara, tiger forests of Nagarhole and Bandipur, coffee hills of Coorg and Chikkamagaluru, and a coast of temples and beaches.
